title: Commit the July–August WIP (Favorites, Universal PTT, DFN3 wiring, mobile companion)
description: The working tree holds ~6 weeks of shipped-but-uncommitted work: person_board Favorites, universal_ptt.py, DeepFilterNet3 GUI wiring, mobile_sync.py, the whole mobile/ Android tree, and models.py hardening. Commit (or split into logical commits) so app-state vs code changes stay separable — the lesson from the 2026-06 data-loss session.
